summary: Playbooks are YAML files with one or more plays in order; each play runs tasks, and each task calls a module.
questions: What is the structure of an Ansible playbook?
What's the difference between a play and a playbook?

answer_card.title: Playbook structure
answer_card.answer_md: A playbook is a YAML list of **plays**. Each play runs one or more **tasks**, and each task calls a **module**.
